candidate_rationale.author: Architecture-neutral mapping of AxBench's joint [5,10,15,20] tuple on its 26-layer source model.
candidate_rationale.shallow: Preregistered shallow-depth alternative without changing four-layer joint geometry.
candidate_rationale.deep: Preregistered deep-depth alternative without changing four-layer joint geometry.
candidate_rationale.stratified: Preregistered evenly spaced alternative covering the full residual stack.

search.sequential_search_rationale: Four tuple trainings expand site opportunity; the full author-side factor grid is evaluated only for the validation-selected tuple to avoid Cartesian overtuning.

additional_candidate_rationale.early: Four-layer joint intervention concentrated in the first half of the residual stack.
additional_candidate_rationale.late: Depth-symmetric counterpart of early, concentrated in the second half.
additional_candidate_rationale.wide: Four-layer joint intervention spanning near-boundary and interior depths.
additional_candidate_rationale.center: Four-layer joint intervention densely covering the middle residual stack.

candidate_budget.rationale: Eight preregistered four-layer joint tuples approximately match the measured ConFiQA RCM plus CAST localization-and-training budget while preserving native LoReFT geometry.

gptj_6b.rationale: Current 20260915 microbatch2 x accumulation18 measurement estimates 196.03 training minutes for the author tuple versus 158.72 for the larger cached CAST timing row. No tuple selection; retain four-layer geometry, 24 epochs and all 14 calibration factors. This is small-sample extrapolation, not equal realized cost.

lion_llama3_8b.rationale: User-approved two-tuple budget on 20260915. Keep the first two entries in the previously registered candidate order: author and shallow; no test-score-based choice. Estimated 294.69 minutes from the three-tuple mean versus CAST 266.44 minutes. Keep four-layer joint geometry, selector300, 24 epochs and all 14 winner calibration factors. Historical deep-tuple evidence remains separate.

User-approved H100 memory adaptation after shallow tuple OOM at microbatch18: all registered tuples use 9 x 4 (effective batch36). Current 20260915 timing uses this split. Old 18 x 2 artifacts remain historical only for this comparison.

gptj_6b.rationale: User-approved 2026-09-14 single-GPU execution adaptation after batch 18 exceeded H100 80GB memory. Effective batch remains 36; both cost measurement and future formal GPT-J LoReFT training use this split. Throughput must be measured under this execution configuration.

tldr.selector_definition: At factor 1, mean over selector rows of avglogp(chosen|prompt) minus avglogp(rejected|prompt), using full registered continuations. No generated summaries or API calls at tuple selection. Alpha-dev and final human-reference judging unchanged.

fairness_statement: LoReFT retains its native four-layer joint geometry and author-side training hyperparameters, with explicitly registered single-device microbatch/accumulation adaptations preserving effective batch. The added tuple search expands baseline opportunity under the same registered data-role isolation as RCM; only the winning tuple receives factor calibration, so tuple and factor are not searched as a Cartesian product.
